commit 99a092c829f57232ed7095a842fdc12f2cbcb521
Author:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
AuthorDate: Wed May 13 12:01:31 2026 -0400
Commit:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
CommitDate: Wed May 13 12:01:31 2026 -0400

    Bug 2039338 - Port bug 2038346: split final verify into per platform tasks. r=#thunderbird-back-end-reviewers
    Port of https://hg-edge.mozilla.org/mozilla-central/rev/ed8db6c03be8e9eac8a431f7a78c38fd798db227 and https://hg-edge.mozilla.org/mozilla-central/rev/7db4f4b7118d39af8eb3e34a7a185d7d5ea0d175.
    
    Reviewed live!

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/release-final-verify/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/release-final-verify/kind.yml
index a87177efd5d..9c8302da1f8 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/release-final-verify/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/release-final-verify/kind.yml
@@ -10,29 +10,29 @@ kind-dependencies:
 
 transforms:
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release:run_on_releases
-    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_deps:transforms
+    - taskgraph.transforms.from_deps
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.final_verify:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.job:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms
 
-task-defaults:
-    run-on-repo-type: [hg]
-    name: final-verify
-    run-on-projects: []  # to make sure this never runs as part of CI
-    worker-type: b-linux
-    worker:
-        docker-image:
-            in-tree: "update-verify"
-        max-run-time: 7200
-        retry-exit-status: [1]
-
 tasks:
-    thunderbird:
+    final-verify:
+        from-deps:
+            kinds: [release-update-verify-config]
+            group-by:
+                # `build_platform` includes `shippable` and `devedition` so
+                # this effectively groups by platform+shipping product
+                attribute: build_platform
+            copy-attributes: true
         description: final verify
         shipping-phase: push
-        shipping-product: thunderbird
         treeherder:
-            platform: thunderbird-release/opt
-            kind: test
-            symbol: Rel(FV)
-            tier: 1
+            symbol: FV
+        run-on-repo-type: [hg]
+        name: final-verify
+        run-on-projects: []  # to make sure this never runs as part of CI
+        worker-type: b-linux
+        worker:
+            docker-image:
+                in-tree: "update-verify"
+            max-run-time: 7200
title: Bug 2039338 - Port bug 2038346: split final verify into per platform tasks. r=#thunderbird-back-end-reviewers Port of https://hg-edge.mozilla.org/mozilla-central/rev/ed8db6c03be8e9eac8a431f7a78c38fd798db227 and https://hg-edge.mozilla.org/mozilla-central/rev/7db4f4b7118d39af8eb3e34a7a185d7d5ea0d175.
